title: Revolución y Estado
goal: Read why building a functioning state after a revolutionary victory is often harder than winning it, and why that phase can turn out more violent than the struggle for power itself.

items: Explain what the real challenge of a genuine revolution is, according to the text.
List the questions successful revolutionary movements must face immediately.
Explain why the post-victory phase can be more violent than the struggle for power.
Describe what many revolutionary movements ended up drifting toward.
Use the simple future to predict a general historical pattern.
